skill.legendweapons.earthshatter.desc: Slam the ground, launching and slowing nearby enemies.

skill.legendweapons.storm_wrath.desc: Summon a thunderstorm that strikes every enemy around you.
skill.legendweapons.titan_quake.desc: Split the earth, launching and crippling all nearby enemies.
